human_summary: This educational material covers the BI-RADS mammography lexicon, focusing primarily on breast density classification and its clinical significance. The content includes detailed categorization of breast tissue, findings such as masses and calcifications, and explains how breast density affects both mammographic accuracy and breast cancer risk. The material is moderately technical and includes visual examples of different breast density categories.
illustrations_note: The material contains numerous figures (Figures 1-16) showing examples of different breast density categories (A-D) in both digital mammography (DM) and screen-film mammography (SM) views. These visual examples are essential for understanding breast density classification and would benefit from image-based identification tasks. Manual image-task authoring is recommended.

not_recommended.reason: Illustrations are present. Image-based tasks are not auto-generated in this flow; consider manually creating 2-4 image tasks in the editor for visual recognition/classification.

recommendations.rationale: Multiple choice questions effectively test knowledge of classifications, categories, and regulatory requirements.
Click text tasks work well for identifying correct assessment methods and factors affecting breast density from a list.
Open answer questions allow students to explain concepts like classification changes and impact on mammographic accuracy in their own words.
Click words tasks can identify correct descriptions of mass characteristics and calcification types from intentionally distorted texts.
Sequence tasks are ideal for categorizing breast density images or descriptions into the correct A-D categories.

warnings: The material includes technical medical terminology that may be challenging for students without prior knowledge of breast imaging.
